input.question: What is Imperialism?
input.ground_truth: A country is being imperialistic when it's asserting power over other countries through militaristic or political (usually militaristic) means. "Imperialism" comes from the world "Imperial," which is a word used to describe any collection of states/territories ran by an emperor or other sovereign figure, also known as an empire (think Star Wars). What really makes a government imperialistic is when it is trying to control/take over other territories. Hope that helps!

Okay! Imagine you have a big box of toys, and you tell your friends, "You can only play with my toys if you do what I say." That's a little bit like imperialism.

Imperialism is when a big country wants to control other smaller countries, just like you might want to control all the toys. The big country might send people over, make rules, or take things from the smaller country to help itself.

So, imperialism is when a strong country tries to be boss over other countries and take care of them the way it wants, not how they want.
